subject: Re: Happy July 4th | Performance Supply Depot | Performance Supply Depot
body:
Dear Valued Partners and Customers,

Happy Independence Day!

As we celebrate freedom, enterprise, and innovation this 4th of July, all
of us at Performance Supply Depot remain committed to powering American
businesses with premium supplies and reliable service.

From thermal rolls to paper supplies and toners, we have your business
covered—because a well-supplied business is a thriving business.

If you are ready to partner with excellence, please scan the QR code below
or reach out today:

[Insert QR Code Here]

  - Website: psdepot.com
  - Email: info@psdepot.com
  - Phone: 888-881-6834 / 415-571-9724

Empowering American Businesses Since Day One.

Best regards,

Antonio Hudnall
Performance Supply Depot LLC

Antonio Hudnall
888-881-6834
415-571-9724
Performance Supply Depot LLC
